style: Original hand-drawn illustration in the style of a vintage 1880s American western dime-novel print: confident ink linework with cross-hatching, muted hand-painted watercolor tints (ochre, rust red, faded turquoise, sepia), aged cream paper texture, dramatic lighting, expressive faces with real human anatomy and natural hand poses. No text, no letters, no logos, no card border or frame.
